patterns.note: A persistent two-column layout where the left column features a large, abstract, and often interactive visual element that remains fixed, while the right column contains all the scrollable textual content.
Section headings are consistently rendered in uppercase, using a clean sans-serif font, providing clear content segmentation without being overly dominant.
A high-contrast palette featuring a light off-white background for content, dark text, and a deep charcoal background for the fixed left visual panel, creating a distinct visual separation.
The large visual element in the left column remains fixed in the viewport as the user scrolls down the page, while the content in the right column scrolls independently.
Content is organized into clearly labeled sections with distinct uppercase headings, often followed by a brief introductory paragraph before listing items (e.g., 'LATEST OUTPUTS', 'STARTING POINTS').

technique_notes: To rebuild the layout, use a CSS grid or flexbox to create a two-column structure. The left column should be set to a fixed width or percentage and have its position set to 'sticky' or 'fixed' to remain in view during scroll. The right column should be scrollable and contain all the page's dynamic content.

Typography should utilize a single, clean sans-serif font family. Section titles should be transformed to uppercase and given a slightly heavier weight than body text, but remain relatively modest in size. Body text should have generous line height for readability.

The motion system involves a fixed element. The left visual panel is positioned to stay in place relative to the viewport, while the main content area is allowed to scroll naturally. No scroll-triggered animations or reveals are used for content within the scrolling area.

design_tokens.type_scale: Modest sans-serif headings (uppercase, ~1.5x body) with a larger, bolder page title on interior pages (~2.5x body).
design_tokens.spacing: airy — generous line-heights and padding around content blocks, creating a spacious feel.

standout: The most distinctive feature is the large, abstract, and persistent visual element on the left side of the screen. This element acts as a dynamic, page-specific backdrop that remains fixed while the textual content scrolls, providing a unique visual anchor and a strong sense of brand identity beyond typical static hero images.
